blocks.html:
What an ordinary week earns at each cadence

$4.4k a week at 1, $5.7k at 2, $10.5k at 3, $13.9k at 4. That's the 10 offer weeks taken out, so it's your normal content weeks, and every step up has beaten the one below it.

Each campaign also keeps earning the same: $3,487 at 3 a week, $3,471 at 4. The fourth send brings its own money rather than pulling it off the first three, and it does it at 0.08% unsubscribes.

blocks.title: What each cadence earns in an ordinary week

blocks.html:
Why I'm asking for 4 and not 5

You've hit 5 a week four times, and every one of them was a week with an offer running, where you averaged $22.7k a week. So I can't tell you what 5 does on a normal week, because you haven't run it on one. 4 I can: you've done that five times, three of them with no offer at all, and those are the weeks the number above comes from.

What I want to try

One more campaign a week, for a month. You've already hit 4 a week five times already, so we'd just be making a good week the normal week. It's worth about $14,817 a month and I'd rather prove that than promise it: four weeks at 4, then I'll read these same figures back to you. If revenue per campaign and unsubscribes hold, we'll go again. If they slip, we stop, and you've learned where your ceiling sits.

This one's on us. You're good clients, so nothing changes on your invoice.

One note on the follow-ups

85 of the 208 emails here were follow-ups to non-openers rather than new campaigns, so I count them separately. Yours earn 108% of what a real campaign earns per person, which is rare. It's free money on creative you've already paid for, so keep them coming.

52 weeks of your own sends, Jun ’25 to Aug ’26, grouped by campaigns per week. The 10 offer weeks are reported separately, 19 promotional weeks sit out (flagged on revenue per recipient, so a cut on total revenue can't delete your busiest weeks), and a cadence is only quoted where you ran it three times or more. Revenue is Klaviyo attributed on last click, so it's the generous reading rather than the truth; a holdout gets you the strict one and I'll happily run one.

reports.summary: Every extra campaign a week has earned more, and each campaign kept earning the same. I'd like to test a fourth send a week for a month, worth about $14,817. On us.
